strings.d1.s0.name: Cours Saleya Market
strings.d1.s0.tips: Flower and food market (antiques on Mondays); try socca (chickpea pancake) at the Chez Thérésa stand, and pan bagnat.
strings.d1.s1.name: Vieux Nice Streets
strings.d1.s1.tips: Ochre-coloured Italianate streets; Sainte-Réparate cathedral, Fenocchio ice cream (100 flavours).
strings.d1.s2.name: Colline du Château
strings.d1.s2.tips: Castle hill with a waterfall and views over the Baie des Anges; free lift (Bellanda tower).
strings.d1.s3.name: Chez Pipo
strings.d1.s3.tips: Wood-fired socca since 1923; next to Port Lympia, expect a queue.
strings.d1.s4.name: Promenade des Anglais
strings.d1.s4.tips: A winter stroll along the promenade and its blue chairs; sunny 15°C.
strings.d1.b0.name: Fenocchio Glacier
strings.d1.b0.tips: Lavender, olive and beer ice cream; on Place Rossetti.
strings.d1.b1.name: Palais Lascaris
strings.d1.b1.tips: Baroque palace with a collection of musical instruments; in Vieux Nice.
strings.d2.s0.name: Musée National Marc Chagall
strings.d2.s0.tips: The 17 paintings of the Biblical Message and stained glass; in Cimiez, bus 15, closed Tuesdays.
strings.d2.s1.name: Musée Matisse
strings.d2.s1.tips: Red Genoese villa; Matisse's cut-outs, olive-grove park (Roman arena).
strings.d2.s2.name: Café Matisse Cimiez
strings.d2.s2.tips: Café in the museum park; salade niçoise.
strings.d2.s3.name: Place Masséna
strings.d2.s3.tips: Red-paved square with statues of the 7 continents (lit up at night); by tram.
strings.d2.s4.name: Promenade du Paillon
strings.d2.s4.tips: Park with a water mirror; walk from Masséna to MAMAC.
strings.d2.b0.name: MAMAC
strings.d2.b0.tips: Modern art (Klein, Niki de Saint Phalle); free rooftop terrace.
strings.d2.b1.name: Lou Pilha Leva Vieux Nice
strings.d2.b1.tips: Socca, pissaladière and beignets eaten standing up.
strings.d3.s0.name: Èze Village
strings.d3.s0.tips: Bus 82/112 (1.50 EUR) or train to Èze-sur-Mer; 1 hour climb up the Nietzsche Path. Medieval eagle's-nest village with a Fragonard perfume factory.
strings.d3.s1.name: Monte-Carlo Casino
strings.d3.s1.tips: Belle Époque casino (entry 19 EUR, visit before 14:00); Café de Paris, Ferraris.
strings.d3.s2.name: Monaco-Ville Rock and Prince's Palace
strings.d3.s2.tips: The old town on the Rock; changing of the guard at 11:55, Cathedral (Grace Kelly's tomb).
strings.d3.s3.name: Marché de la Condamine
strings.d3.s3.tips: Monaco's market food hall; barbagiuan and socca, the affordable side of Monaco.
strings.d3.s4.name: Oceanographic Museum
strings.d3.s4.tips: Cousteau's aquarium on the cliff edge; rooftop views.
strings.d3.b0.name: Jardin Exotique de Monaco
strings.d3.b0.tips: Monaco's cactus garden and cave; an alternative to the aquarium.
strings.d3.b1.name: Le Nid d'Aigle Èze
strings.d3.b1.tips: Terrace restaurant at the top of the village.
strings.d4.s0.name: Villefranche-sur-Mer
strings.d4.s0.tips: 7 minutes by train; colourful harbour, Cocteau's Saint-Pierre chapel, Rue Obscure tunnel.
strings.d4.s1.name: Plage des Marinières
strings.d4.s2.name: Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild
strings.d4.s2.tips: Pink villa with 9 themed gardens; musical fountains every 20 minutes, tea room.
strings.d4.s3.name: Sentier du Littoral Cap Ferrat
strings.d4.s3.tips: Coastal path around the peninsula; Saint-Jean harbour, Paloma beach.
strings.d4.s4.name: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat Harbour
strings.d4.s4.tips: Harbour café; a billionaires' village among the Rothschild villas.
strings.d4.b0.name: La Mère Germaine Villefranche
strings.d4.b1.name: Villa Kérylos Beaulieu
strings.d4.b1.tips: Replica of a Greek villa on the seafront; an alternative to Ephrussi.
strings.d5.s0.name: Marché Provençal Antibes
strings.d5.s0.tips: 25 minutes by train; covered Provençal market, olives and tapenade.
strings.d5.s1.name: Musée Picasso Antibes
strings.d5.s1.tips: Picasso's 1946 studio in the Grimaldi castle; sculptures on the sea terrace.
strings.d5.s2.name: Cannes La Croisette
strings.d5.s2.tips: 10 minutes by train; handprints at the Palais des Festivals, palm trees.
strings.d5.s3.name: Le Suquet Cannes
strings.d5.s3.tips: Old town hill; lunch near Marché Forville with views over the harbour.
strings.d5.s4.name: Île Sainte-Marguerite
strings.d5.b0.name: Plage de la Gravette Antibes
strings.d5.b1.name: Astoux et Brun Cannes
strings.d6.s0.name: Saint-Paul-de-Vence
strings.d6.s0.tips: Train to Cagnes plus bus 655; walled artists' village, Chagall's grave, galleries, pétanque at Café de la Place.
strings.d6.s1.name: Fondation Maeght
strings.d6.s1.tips: Miró labyrinth, Giacometti courtyard, Chagall mosaic; one of Europe's finest modern art foundations.
strings.d6.s2.name: La Colombe d'Or
strings.d6.s2.tips: The inn where Picasso and Matisse left paintings in exchange for meals; terrace (reservation needed) or café outside meal service.
strings.d6.s3.name: Chapelle du Rosaire Vence
strings.d6.s3.tips: The chapel Matisse called his masterpiece; check its afternoon opening hours.
strings.d6.s4.name: Vence Old Town
strings.d6.s4.tips: Medieval town; Chagall mosaic in the cathedral, then the bus back.
strings.d6.b0.name: Le Tilleul Saint-Paul
strings.d6.b0.tips: Terrace under a linden tree; a good alternative to the Colombe.
strings.d6.b1.name: Renoir Museum Cagnes
strings.d6.b1.tips: Renoir's last home, set in an olive grove; an alternative to Vence.
strings.d7.theme: Seaside morning and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Plage Beau Rivage Morning Swim
strings.d7.s1.name: Marché de la Libération
strings.d7.s1.tips: The locals' market (Gare du Sud); pissaladière and cheese.
strings.d7.s2.name: Confiserie Florian
strings.d7.s2.tips: Crystallised flowers and fruit sweets; by the harbour, good for souvenirs.
strings.d7.s3.name: La Merenda
strings.d7.s3.tips: A Niçoise legend with 12 tables, no phone and no cards; daube and stockfish, a farewell meal.
strings.d7.s4.name: Tram 2 to the Airport
strings.d7.s4.tips: 25 minutes to the airport on tram 2; farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Le Safari Cours Saleya
strings.d7.b0.tips: Niçoise classics on the market terrace.
strings.d7.b1.name: Musée Masséna
strings.d7.b1.tips: Belle Époque villa and the history of Nice; on the Promenade.
strings.note0: A Lignes d'Azur ticket costs 1.50 EUR (bus and tram), or 5 EUR for a day pass; TER trains run along the coast (Monaco 20 min, Cannes 30 min). Tram 2 goes to the airport.
strings.note1: Winter is sunny at 12-15°C (Europe's winter retreat). February brings the Nice Carnival and the Menton Lemon Festival. April-May and October are ideal, and the sea is warm enough for swimming until October.
strings.note2: Socca 4 EUR, pan bagnat 6, salade niçoise 15, restaurants 25-40, museums 10 (Nice museum pass 15 EUR/3 days); round up the bill for a tip.
strings.note3: Monaco's casino is open to tourists before 14:00 and has an evening dress code; go to Èze in the morning; book ahead for La Colombe d'Or, and remember La Merenda has no phone.
strings.note4: Watch for pickpockets on tram 1 and at Cours Saleya; don't leave belongings on the beaches.
strings.note5: Rosé de Provence, pastis, tarte tropézienne; Nice's cuisine blends Italian and Provençal.
